defects.defect: The ranged mage (Sage) is drawn at a noticeably larger scale and different art weight than the melee mages and the goblins, breaking the depth/scale rule (further back should not be bigger)
defects.direction: Match the ranged mage's sprite scale to the melee mages, slightly smaller given her deeper camp-ledge position
defects.region: arena, ranged mage ~(500-600, 990-1105) vs melee mages ~(370-530, 615-770)

defects.defect: The advancing goblins overlap into a dense stack, weakening individual enemy silhouettes and the battle read.
defects.direction: Spread the goblins slightly across the upper arena with clearer depth separation.

defects.defect: The red enemy HP bar floats detached to the right of the goblin cluster instead of anchoring above a specific unit
defects.direction: Center the HP bar directly above its owning goblin and keep it tracking that sprite
defects.region: enemy HP bar right of goblin pack, ~(505,510)

defects.defect: The two melee mages overlap almost completely — the red-haired mage's body is occluded by the dwarf sprite, reading as one tangled blob rather than two distinct advancing units
defects.direction: Separate the melee mages horizontally by at least one sprite width and give each its own footprint shadow so both silhouettes read

defects.defect: The stage track is a thin bare line pinned to the extreme left edge with nodes partly cropped by the screen edge and no framed rail or stage labels
defects.direction: Inset the track from the edge, thicken/frame the rail and give nodes consistent inner icons so no node is clipped

defects.defect: The bottom half of the arena is nearly empty sand — props (cacti, skulls, rocks) all cluster in the upper half, so the environment does not read as a finished dressed field
defects.direction: Distribute props across the full arena height, adding mid/foreground dressing near the camp ledge so density is even
defects.region: arena lower third, y≈870-1130 across full width

defects.defect: The red “13” overlaps character art and its dark outline reduces immediate readability.
defects.direction: Move it into clearer negative space and increase contrast against the sprites.
defects.region: damage number above Bastion, around x495 y625

defects.defect: All three HP bars are rendered fully red at 100% fill, so a full-health bar looks like a critical-damage state and carries no fill/track contrast
defects.direction: Use a green/gold fill on a dark inset track with a visible frame so fill level is legible

defects.defect: A large uninterrupted sand area separates the combat from Sage and the camp, making the arena feel a little sparse.
defects.direction: Add subtle terrain variation or a few low-contrast props while preserving combat clarity.

defects.defect: The two melee mages overlap each other heavily, with Ember's punching arm reading as merged into the dwarf's body
defects.direction: Offset the two melee mages vertically/horizontally so each silhouette stays readable during the engagement

defects.defect: The speed chip and pause button are not vertically centered against the Level/Stage title block and the pause button's brown plate sits flush with the frame's inner edge
defects.direction: Center both controls on the title block's vertical midpoint and add equal inner padding from the frame border
defects.region: top strip, speed chip 1x ~(35-130, 240-295) and pause ~(610-700, 230-300)

defects.defect: HP numerals sit flush to the card's left inner border and are unframed plain text, unlike the rest of the framed HUD styling
defects.direction: Center the numerals over the bar or pad them off the frame edge, matching the card's ornamented style

defects.defect: The ranged mage stands slightly above the camp ledge on open sand rather than holding the ledge line
defects.direction: Move Sage down to stand on or just above the brown camp ledge near the tent/campfire

defects.defect: The damage number sits behind/overlapped by the goblin and mage sprites and shares the same dark-red tone as nearby art, hurting readability
defects.direction: Draw damage numbers above all sprites with a light outline/shadow and a small rise offset

defects.defect: All three HP bars render the same salmon-red at full/near-full health, muting the at-a-glance health read
defects.direction: Use a green-to-red gradient or state-based tint so full HP reads healthy and distinct from damaged

defects.defect: Stage track nodes are visually mixed (diamond top, hollow circles, one filled) without a clear current-stage marker matching 'Stage 2/4'
defects.direction: Style the track so completed, current, and upcoming stage nodes are clearly differentiated and count matches 4 stages

defects.defect: The goblin group HP bar is a bare rounded rect detached from the group, floating to the right of the goblins with no frame or anchor
defects.direction: Center the bar over the goblin group and frame it to match the HUD's wooden/gold styling

defects.defect: The camp ledge is a flat unlit brown band holding only a tent and campfire, with a hard seam against the sand and unused empty middle
defects.direction: Add texture/props and soften the sand-to-ledge transition so the camp reads as painted ground
